source.name: GeoNames gazetteer, Ghana extract (populated places)
source.coverage: 15964 populated places and neighbourhoods with approximate points. District links derived for 12768; 3145 near a boundary and 51 outside every matched polygon are left unlinked.
source.notes: Crowd-sourced gazetteer; names and points are not official. District links are derived from geoBoundaries gbOpen GHA ADM2 (CC BY 4.0, USAID/GSS, 2019) polygons and marked UNVERIFIED. Points are approximate centres, never anyone's location.
